tune.title: Tune my feed
tune.description: You decide what rises. Every setting applies right away.
tune.how: Each problem gets a score: your interests × its freshness × its quality (helpful answers, solved or not) × your level. About one slot in eight (≈ 12%) is kept for exploration, so you don’t end up in a bubble. The feed aims to get you unblocked and to let you unblock others, not to keep you here as long as possible.
tune.empty: You don’t follow any topic yet.
tune.emptyHint: Add one so the feed knows what to show you.
tune.resetHint: Forget what the feed learned from your activity and go back to your starting choices.
tune.resetBody: Weights learned from your reads will be erased. Topics picked at sign-up and those you added by hand are kept.
tune.resetDone: Learning reset: your feed starts again from your initial choices.
